environment: Anonymous local Convex and real Chromium browser contexts; no production deployment.
auditScope: Exploratory interaction audit during implementation, including the fixes frozen in fe914fc. The separately linked full-game receipt reruns the committed source.

checks: Tabs support arrow-key focus and Enter activation; empty name and short code focus associated errors and preserve field values.

Twelve real guests join, including the prefilled invite-link flow; full names and roster fit 320px. Leave confirmation traps focus, starts on Stay, cancels with Escape, restores menu focus, and preserves membership.
At 200% root text, rules and invitations remain bounded and scrollable on 320px; fixed intrinsic grid sizing and an overflowing room code found by this audit.
Writing drafts survive reload; other submissions do not steal typing focus; accepted answers focus their receipt. End-writing defaults to Keep writing, cancels safely, and restores focus.
Rules initially focus their heading rather than jumping to the last disclosure. Modal gutters stay 16px during text resizing.

Thirteen choices including 180-character unbroken bluffs fit 320px; own answer is disabled. Space/arrow keys select without submitting; Lock vote focuses an accepted receipt, which remains private and survives reload.
Active voting fits 390px portrait and 667×375 landscape; reduced motion removes button transitions; forced-colors choices remain labelled and outlined.

Canceled reveal keeps truth private; confirmed host reveal skips outstanding votes and shows linked provenance. A non-host continues immediately. An exact-truth author gets a clear two-point/no-vote receipt without radio controls.
A real all-skipped rematch, advanced through authorized host mutations, renders a twelve-way tie with shared rank 1 and all twelve winners.

designFormat.note: The alpha linter does not count CSS border, input-boundary, or focus-ring usage as component token references. These three colors are used in the implementation.

limitations: Chromium mobile/touch emulation, not physical-device or screen-reader testing.
The hosted deployment was not updated or exercised.
The twelve-way tie was prepared using real authorized host mutations, not by manually playing an additional six rounds.
retention: Six deliberately selected design-reference images and compact receipts are retained here. Full fresh multiplayer screenshots are retained by the revision-specific CI artifact; exploratory captures remain under ignored test-results.

rounds.question: What is the dark 'sand' in Titan's vast dune fields made from?
rounds.truth: Carbon-rich hydrocarbon grains rather than ordinary rocky sand.

rounds.question: Why did Apollo 15 use a falcon feather alongside a geological hammer on the Moon?
rounds.truth: To drop them together and show that both fall at the same rate without air resistance.

rounds.question: Why did Max Ernst lay paper on an old wooden floor and rub over it with a pencil?
rounds.truth: To capture the wood's texture as the starting point for imagined pictures.

rounds.question: What was a printer's 'tympan' used for?
rounds.truth: Holding a blank sheet in position to be pressed onto the printing form.

rounds.question: What sound does a creature make when it 'ululates'?
rounds.truth: A howl or wail, as of a dog or wolf.

rounds.question: In its literal older sense, what activity is 'lucubration'?

checks: Three independent guest identities join by code; real Parlor QR invitation renders in the lobby.
Unauthenticated room game read rejected; writing hides truth, source, and options.
Explicit host departure transfers host to Bea; rejoining Ada keeps identity, scores, and match eligibility.
Late joiner can watch but cannot submit; immutable three-player eligibility preserved.
Phone network interruption and reload preserve the same player and current turn.
Six rounds have authoritative expected scores18/8/0, private shuffled choices, duplicate-bluff attribution, rejected self-votes, and idempotent submission retries.
Rematch includes former spectator, resets all scores, draws unseen content, and fits390px screens without horizontal overflow.
